assets.content:
Subject: Match your kit to your repairs
Preview text: Look beyond bit count to the opening and handling work you expect.

Choose tools for the repairs ahead

Hi there,

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit gives you a general electronics repair kit for working across electronics, gaming consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices. Start by checking whether that range matches what you expect to fix.

Its 64-bit driver set is one part of that decision. Bit count tells you about fasteners, but it does not show how a toolkit supports the opening and handling steps that may follow.

The Pro Tech Toolkit also includes an assortment of tweezers, spudgers, opening tools, and anti-static safety accessories. That combination makes it a broader starting point than a driver set alone.

Compare the listed device range and included tools with the repairs you plan to attempt. That is the practical test of whether this breadth fits—or whether a smaller option would cover your needs.

Review the Pro Tech Toolkit →

- iFixit

assets.title: A case that sorts fasteners
assets.content:
Subject: A case that sorts fasteners
Preview text: The magnetic lid has a second job once fasteners come out.

Turn the driver case into a sorting surface

Hi there,

The driver case can stay useful after you open it. The 64 Bit Driver Kit’s magnetic lid doubles as a sorting tray, providing a dedicated surface for removed fasteners while you work.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit is an electronics repair toolkit centered on that driver set. Its case does more than store the bits between repairs: part of it becomes a working surface during disassembly.

As fasteners come out, use the inside of the lid to keep them together. You decide how to arrange them; the tray gives you a built-in place to do it.

See the magnetic lid on the Pro Tech Toolkit product page and decide whether that integrated sorting surface would help at your workbench.

See the case and sorting tray →

- iFixit

emails.subject_strategy: Earn attention with one specific repair action—precise prying—rather than reciting the full toolkit inventory.
must_not_reuse: The Pro Tech Toolkit fits a first general toolkit role when the reader expects to work across several electronics categories and needs opening and handling tools as well as precision bits.

emails.job: Resolve the supported concern that a first general toolkit may not remain useful beyond a small number of repairs.
emails.single_idea: The Pro Tech Toolkit carries a Lifetime Guarantee, with a defined promise and a separate boundary for consumable items.
emails.felt_need: If I invest in a general toolkit, I want to understand what support exists if a covered tool fails over time.
emails.status_quo: The reader may postpone a broader toolkit purchase if its useful life and guarantee terms are unclear.
emails.why_it_fails: A generic durability claim does not explain what is promised or where the coverage stops.
emails.mechanism: The product page identifies a Lifetime Guarantee. iFixit's guarantee states that the covered product is guaranteed to function for as long as the customer has it, while consumable products in the Pro Tech Toolkit carry their own as-is coverage.

alternative_arguments.single_idea: For eligible domestic orders, the Pro Tech Toolkit's listed price clears iFixit's published free-shipping threshold.
alternative_arguments.felt_need: I want to know whether shipping could add to the listed toolkit price.
alternative_arguments.status_quo: A shopper may see the product price without knowing the published domestic shipping threshold.
alternative_arguments.why_it_fails: The item price alone does not answer shipping eligibility.
alternative_arguments.mechanism: The Pro Tech Toolkit is listed at $79.95, while iFixit publishes free shipping on domestic orders of $75 or more.
alternative_arguments.belief_shift: Before: shipping eligibility is unknown from the toolkit price alone. After: the listed price is above the published threshold for eligible domestic orders.
must_not_say: That free shipping applies internationally or to every destination.
That taxes, duties, surcharges, or delivery timing are included.
That the price or shipping policy will remain unchanged.
Any invented discount, deadline, or promotional scarcity.
alternative_arguments.objection: Shipping might make the toolkit cost more than the listed product price.
alternative_arguments.call_to_action: Check the listed price and domestic shipping information on the Pro Tech Toolkit product page: https://www.ifixit.com/products/pro-tech-toolkit
alternative_arguments.next_step_decision: Determine whether the order qualifies for the published domestic free-shipping threshold.
alternative_arguments.next_step_value: The page shows the toolkit's listed price and iFixit's domestic free-shipping threshold.
alternative_arguments.next_step_limit: The threshold does not establish eligibility for an international address or account for taxes, duties, and other destination-specific charges.
alternative_arguments.subject_strategy: Use a precise threshold-and-price comparison, clearly limited to eligible domestic orders.

emails.belief_shift: Before: the toolkit could become an unsupported purchase after a few repairs. After: covered tools have a stated lifetime-function promise, while consumables and user-caused damage remain outside that broad reading.
must_not_say: That every item in the toolkit receives lifetime replacement.
That the guarantee covers consumables, normal consumption, misuse, negligence, loss, installation damage, device damage, accidental damage, or data loss.
That the guarantee insures the reader's device or guarantees a successful repair.
That claims are automatic, unconditional, or free of regional shipping requirements.
Any invented discount, deadline, or cart activity.
emails.objection: I do not want my first general toolkit to become a short-lived purchase with no support if a covered tool fails.
emails.call_to_action: Review the Pro Tech Toolkit and its Lifetime Guarantee on the product page: https://www.ifixit.com/products/pro-tech-toolkit
emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether the documented guarantee and its boundaries provide enough purchase reassurance.
emails.next_step_value: The product page identifies the Lifetime Guarantee, while the official terms explain the lifetime-function promise and the separate treatment of consumables.
emails.next_step_limit: The guarantee does not cover every toolkit item in the same way and does not cover user-caused device damage or guarantee repair outcomes.
emails.subject_strategy: Address longevity directly while signaling that the email will explain the guarantee's real boundary, not merely repeat the word 'lifetime.'
must_not_reuse: The Pro Tech Toolkit fits a first general toolkit role when the reader expects to work across several electronics categories and needs opening and handling tools as well as precision bits.
The included Jimmy gives the reader a purpose-built option when a repair step calls for precise, forceful prying.

brief.voice_notes: Use short, practical sentences and iFixit's repair vocabulary. Speak as 'we' only when representing iFixit and address the reader as 'you.' Keep the sequence empowering without implying that every repair is easy, safe, compatible, or guaranteed. Each email should make one argument and use the product-page link as its only ask.
